# Record of Resistance

**Course:** CORE-101
**Project:** P1-cycle-project
**Date:** 2026-05-02
**Record #:** 2

---

## What AI Suggested

> Pair a humanist sans-serif with a modern geometric display face: "this is what's currently trending in editorial design."

---

## Why I Rejected or Revised It

> "Currently trending" is convention, not intent. Element 3 explicitly forbids accepting suggestions on that justification alone.

---

## What I Did Instead

> Chose a single typeface family with deliberate weight contrasts. The variation lives inside one voice instead of across two.
